name: anki-week
description: Build a week's AnKing Step Deck study set from lecture materials — map each lecture's objectives to AnKing cards, unsuspend + tag them, build a filtered deck per lecture, coverage-audit every objective, then hand off to study-week. Also builds interactive, source-grounded NBME/USMLE-style practice exams from those same materials, with a validated faculty blueprint and a remediation report. Deck building requires Anki desktop open with the Anki MCP Server add-on (code 124672614); the exam builder does not.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a week of lectures into the right AnKing cards — and a practice exam
interface.longDescription: Reads your lecture materials first, builds a concept inventory per lecture, then finds the matching AnKing Step Deck cards by tag, unsuspends and tags them, builds one filtered deck per lecture, and audits that every concept the lecture taught is covered. Bring your own AnKing deck. Needs Anki desktop open with the Anki MCP Server add-on (code 124672614) — so it runs where it can reach localhost. Also ships practice-exam-builder, which turns the same slides, review materials and professor-posted questions into an interactive NBME/USMLE-style practice exam in an in-app surface — faculty blueprint enforced before a single question is written, every item traced to a slide, and a scored report that routes each miss to a video, a card, or a test-taking fix. The exam builder needs no Anki connection.
defaultPrompt: Build this week's Anki cards from my lecture slides.
Refresh the deck for week 3 — new slides were posted.
Build me a 60-question practice exam for the cardio block from these lectures.
Resume my practice exam and show me the report when I'm done.
